lookValidation.method: Actual pipeline uniforms/parameters and UI state; central-pixel nonblack smoke checks. Images retain animation.

video.captureMethod: Fixture-only CDP JPEG screencast; original timestamps -> ffconcat with per-file framerate=1000 -> FFmpeg libvpx VFR. No frame duplication or speedup.
video.recordingOverhead: Screencast JPEG capture and subsequent CPU encoding occur outside the existing scene FPS measurements.

ffmpeg.version: ffmpeg version 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers

videoVerification.method: Offscreen Electron at 60Hz presents the existing Blob WebM sequentially at 1x without seeking. requestVideoFrameCallback records the presentation timeline; sampled RGBA pixels are hashed and exported as JPEG for visual QA.

sourceAlignment.method: One encoded frame per captured JPEG; PTS compared with original CDP timestamps, allowing at most 2ms container/time-base quantization.

decode.limitation: Callback timeline describes actual presented frames, not a demuxed enumeration of every encoded packet. JPEG samples cover the four view midpoints and the tail.
